top_signals.title: Pakistan, Afghanistan Trade Claims Over Border Strikes
top_signals.summary: Afghanistan’s Taliban government accused Pakistan of attacking civilian areas in the country, raising the risk of renewed cross-border hostilities, while Islamabad said it had struck militant hideouts and training camps along the Afghan border.
